content: Bawang, once a dominant Chinese anti-hair-loss brand, collapsed from a 20-billion HKD market cap to a penny stock. Its decline resulted from mismanaging the 2010 diethoxane scandal, over-reliance on marketing over R&D, and failed diversifications into unrelated sectors. Ignoring evolving consumer preferences for multi-functional, science-backed solutions and medical treatments, Bawang remained stagnant in the shampoo category. Competitors like Mandy captured significant market share by offering effective ingredients, leaving Bawang with minimal profits and a negligible market presence.

content: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman announced the company will not pursue an IPO in 2026, citing existential AI safety risks over financial gains. He highlighted concerns regarding recursive self-improvement and the potential loss of human control, referencing recent security breaches. While acknowledging a 10% probability of existential risk within a decade, Altman maintained that prioritizing safety over commercial interests is essential for humanity's survival.

content: China's smart glasses market saw a 98.7% sales value increase in the first half of 2024, though July retail volume dropped due to promotional effects. The market is sharply differentiating: AR glasses are surging in adoption thanks to irreplaceable near-eye display capabilities and AI integration. Conversely, audio and camera glasses face declining demand because their functions are easily substituted by existing devices like smartphones and earbuds. While feature convergence is a growing trend, AR devices lead the industry as audio and camera functions become secondary modules rather than standalone products.

title: 官宣，OpenAI关停史上最快模型
content: OpenAI is discontinuing GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark, its first real-time coding model, due to declining usage and superior replacements. Launched on Cerebras hardware to prove non-NVIDIA viability, Spark prioritized speed over accuracy. Cerebras’ Ultrafast mode now delivers full flagship model performance at 750 tokens per second. Spark’s 7-month lifespan marks the end of trading intelligence for speed. OpenAI is transitioning to a tiered pricing model where speed is a paid option for flagship models, replacing dedicated "fast" variants with faster execution tiers of primary systems.

content: Cognition, founded by three Chinese-American informatics Olympians, reached a $48 billion valuation after a $2 billion funding round. title: 突发，A社创始人呼吁AI圈踩刹车，奥特曼马斯克罕见力挺
content: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urged slowing frontier AI development to prevent existential risks, specifically addressing recursive self-improvement and autonomous agent threats. He proposed a three-step plan involving third-party onsite audits, national coordination, and global agreements. Unusually, OpenAI’s Sam Altman and Elon Musk supported these calls. Amodei emphasized that limiting speed allows time for alignment and security improvements, arguing that the U.S. must maintain a technological lead over China to effectively negotiate global safety standards.
